anomalies.description: CRITICAL INFRA BUG. GitHub's configured default branch for hockeman/robinhood is pinned to the original bootstrap commit (d5697362242d33374f172936671b2c2f38a10f12, on branch claude/clever-thompson-2hr5eq) and has never been changed. Because of this, every scheduled run's session cold-starts on a brand-new throwaway branch off that same stale commit instead of continuing from the previous run's state. Over 60 such sibling branches accumulated between 2026-09-18T22:17Z and 2026-09-21T13:23Z, the large majority of them never merged anywhere, each holding a fragment of that run's own journal entry and its own from-scratch guess at state.json. A 2026-09-20 mitigation (documented in AGENT.md) had later runs fetch and push to a branch named 'main'; that worked for a few runs (through 2026-09-21T10:16Z) but then silently stopped again on at least 3 subsequent runs (11:16Z, 12:15Z, 13:23Z) that cold-started and never reached main. A 2026-09-21T13:32Z run found that its own actual scheduled-task instructions (delivered fresh by the scheduler, not read from this repo) named a *different* branch, 'claude/journal', creating a second, unreconciled persistence convention alongside 'main' and the per-session throwaway branches.
anomalies.action_taken: Fully reconciled and resolved in a 2026-09-21T13:35Z maintenance session (this one): read every one of the 60+ branches on the remote, merged all account_value_history entries (62 unique, no numeric conflicts), all 63 journal files (61 unique dates + 2 disambiguated same-timestamp duplicates, renamed with a '-b' suffix), all distinct anomalies, and this notification system's own state, onto one new permanent branch, 'claude/trading-state', verified pushed to origin (see RECONCILIATION.md on that branch for the full audit trail and the exact commit SHA). AGENT.md and this run's saved-Instructions replacement text now name 'claude/trading-state' as the single persistence target and explicitly retire the 'main' and 'claude/journal' conventions. REMAINING OWNER ACTION (the only thing an agent session cannot do itself): GitHub repo Settings -> General -> Default branch, change it from 'claude/clever-thompson-2hr5eq' to 'claude/trading-state', so future sessions cold-start on the branch that actually has continuity. Until that setting is changed, every future session must still explicitly fetch and check out origin/claude/trading-state itself before doing anything else (now written into the replacement Instructions) rather than relying on the default checkout.
anomalies.status: reconciled_2026-09-21; one manual GitHub setting still required from the owner
